app_info.subtitle: Keep project truth aligned
app_info.description: Phewsh lets people and AI tools resume from the same membership-scoped project record. It lists projects, loads a bounded Project · Next · Work · Record snapshot, reads the ordered change ledger, and records proposed decisions or handoffs with provenance and revision checks.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists metadata for projects the signed-in user owns or belongs to.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private Phewsh project records and does not change public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, delete, supersede, or revoke any record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves a bounded membership-scoped project snapshot and freshness cursor.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private Phewsh project records and does not change public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, delete, supersede, or revoke any record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves ordered ledger events after a caller-provided project revision.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads a private Phewsh ledger and does not change public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, delete, supersede, or revoke any record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a private proposed or observed decision and its append-only project event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only the signed-in user's private Phewsh project record and never publishes externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: When supersedes_id is supplied, it changes the prior decision's durable status to superseded.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a private proposed handoff and its append-only project event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only the signed-in user's private Phewsh project record and never messages or publishes externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new handoff without deleting, overwriting, superseding, or revoking an existing record.

test_cases.description: List the signed-in user's available continuity projects.
test_cases.user_prompt: List my Phewsh projects and tell me which one changed most recently.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only the user's membership-scoped projects with role, revision, and update time, then identifies the most recently updated project.

test_cases.description: Load a bounded project snapshot while preserving verification labels.
test_cases.user_prompt: Load the active context for Phewsh Reviewer Demo and separate recorded facts from proposed items.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns Project, Next, Work, and Record data with freshness, revision, and verification labels without presenting cloud claims as repository proof.

test_cases.description: Read ordered project changes after a known revision.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show what changed in Phewsh Reviewer Demo after revision 0.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns ordered ledger events, the latest revision, and whether another page remains while treating provenance labels as claimed.

test_cases.description: Record a bounded proposed project decision.
test_cases.user_prompt: Record this as a proposed decision in Phewsh Reviewer Demo: keep desktop dispatch outside the current release.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one proposed decision with a new revision and does not claim human approval or repository verification.

test_cases.description: Create a resumable proposed project handoff.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a Phewsh Reviewer Demo handoff saying the Workspace proof is complete and the next steps are OAuth acceptance and provider review.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one proposed handoff with the summary, two next steps, claimed provenance, and a new project revision.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Phewsh to operate a code repository.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Run my test suite, fix any failures, and push the branch.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Phewsh should not be invoked because it records continuity and cannot execute code or push repositories.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Phewsh for unrelated calendar management.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Move tomorrow's team meeting to Friday afternoon.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Phewsh should not be invoked because it does not read or modify calendars.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Phewsh to send external communications.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Email the launch announcement to our customer list.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Phewsh should not be invoked because it cannot send messages or publish content.
